title: 040-01 Heizung
description: Die bestehende Heizungsanlage befindet sich im Untergeschoss der Mittelschule und wird am Ende der Umbaumaßnahmen demontiert. Die Demontagearbeiten umfassen einen kellergeschweißten Öltank mit ca. 17.000 Liter Inhalt inkl. der Ölfüll- und Entlüftungsleitungen, dieser befindet sich neben dem Zwischenbau der Verwaltung im Untergeschoss. Des Weiteren muss die Gaskesselanlage ca. 460 kW und die Ölkesselanlage ca. 405 kW fachgerecht außer Betrieb genommen und demontiert werden. Das bestehende Blockheizkraftwerk (BHKW / 80kW thermisch / 50 kW elektrisch) befindet sich im Untergeschoss der Mittelschule und bleibt an dieser Position, dieses wird wieder in die neue Anlage eingebunden. Die neue Heizungsanlage befindet sich im Untergeschoss des Neubaus der Erweiterung der Mittelschule und besteht aus zwei Biomassekesseln mit einer Leistung von jeweils ca. 450 kW. Der Betrieb der Kesselanlagen wird mit Hackgut als auch Pellets ausgeführt, sodass der Bauherr sich beide Optionen offenhält. Die Abgasanlage der beiden Biomasseanlagen ist ebenfalls zu erstellen. Die Bunkeranlage wird mit zwei getrennten Rührwerken (Bunkern) eines für jeden Kessel ausgeführt. Die neu entstehende Heizzentrale mit den genannten Wärmeerzeugern umfasst den Betrieb von mehreren Gebäuden (verschiedene Schul- und nicht Schulgebäude), auch aktuell werden diese angeschlossenen Gebäude durch die Heizzentrale von der Schule Waging versorgt. Die alte Heizungsanlage wird erst demontiert, wenn die neue Heizungsanlage vollständig in Betrieb ist, damit ist ein ständiger Betrieb für die Abnehmer durch den Versorger gewährleistet. Auch die Neubauten der Grundschule, OGTS 1-4, Verwaltungsbau, Erweiterung der Mittelschule OGTS 5-10 mit Aula/Pausenhalle und Speiseraum werden durch die neue Anlage versorgt. In der neuen Technikzentrale befinden sich vier Heizungspufferspeicher mit je 7.000 Liter Volumen, diese müssen eingebracht werden, bevor die Decke über dem Untergeschoss gesetzt wird. Des Weiteren befinden sich in der Technikzentrale die folgenden Bauteile und Materialien wie eine Entgasung/Druckhaltung mit Nachspeisung, Heizungsverteiler thermisch getrennt für 11 Abgänge von DN 40 – DN 125 inkl. Pumpen, Armaturen, Wärmedämmung, Schmutzfänger, Fühler, Einbau von MSR-Mischventilen und Ventile, Thermometer, Strangregulierventile und diverse Bezeichnungsschilder. Die Rohrleitungen mittels Gewinderohr mittelschwer geschweißt von DN 15 – DN 125 + Formstücke, Brandschotts, Bezeichnungsschilder, Entleerungen und Befüllungen sowie Dichtheitsprüfungen und Beprobung des Heizungswassers. Zur Anbindung des Zwischenbaus der Mittelschule Verwaltung von der Heizzentrale aus, wird eine Nahwärmeleitung ins Erdreich verlegt, diese besteht aus zwei Einzelrohren. Die Heizungsseitige (Vor- und Rücklauf zu den Heizregistern) Anbindung von der Heizzentrale zu den fünf Lüftungsgeräten ist ebenfalls herzustellen. Die heizungsseitige Versorgung (Raumheizflächen) der Neubauten wird mittels Fußbodenheizung ausgeführt. Fußbodenheizung mit ca. 24.000 m Systemrohr, ca. 3.500 m² Systemplatte, Randdämmstreifen, keine Tacker/da Klettsystem, ca. 440 Klemmringverschraubungen, Rohrführungsbögen, Schutzhülsen + sonstige Komponente, 21 Heizkreisverteiler und Verteilerschränke von 4 – 14 Heizkreisen, Einregulierung und Beschriften der Heizkreise in den Verteilern (hydraulisch abgleichen), Montage von bauseits gelieferten Stellmotoren, Belegreif-/Funktionsheizen des Estrich in mehreren Bauabschnitten mit einer bereitgestellten und programmierten Regelung zur Ansteuerung der Pumpe, Mischer und Fühler. Weitere projektbezogene Anforderungen sind die Baustelleneinrichtung, fahrbares Gerüst, Stahlkonstruktionen und Befestigungen, Verschließen von Wand- und Deckendurchführungen mit Brandschutzanforderung, Einweisung Personal des Bauherrn, Erstellung von Protokollen wie Dichtheitsprüfung, Analyse Heizungsfüllwasser, Inbetriebnahme. Einbringung der Bauteile über Einbringschacht (außer Pufferspeicher vorab), Erstellen von Bestandsplänen und Bestandsunterlagen, Wartungsleistungen, Hydraulischer Abgleich, Koordinationsleistungen und Schnittstellen der weiteren Gewerke wie MSR, Sanitär, Lüftung, Elektro. Anschluss vom neuen Heizungsverteiler an die bestehenden Abgänge der Abnehmer im Untergeschoss.

Palveluiden sisältö sekä vaatimukset on kuvattu liitteenä olevissa palvelukuvauksissa. Toimitusehdot ja laatuvaatimukset pysyvät vähintään tarjouspyynnön tasolla koko sopimuskauden. buyer: Agentur für Innovation in der Cybersicherheit GmbH
title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [Ne-Trust] Negative Trust Architectures
description: IT systems face an increasing threat from insiders - individuals who often move through systems undetected, exploring IT infrastructure and causing damage. The growing awareness of this attack vector is further amplified by the use of artificial intelligence (AI). These current and future challenges also extend to the realms of public administration, defense, and security agencies. To be prepared for such threat scenarios, IT security paradigms are of critical importance: they shape the fundamental ways in which IT systems are designed, operated, and protected. "Zero Trust" is the most well-established example; however, as a countermeasure against insider threats, this approach has its limitations. Key foundational documents, such as the NIST SP 800-207 guideline, point to remaining gaps and areas that require further research. Against this backdrop, there is a need to explore an advanced, novel paradigm for more effectively defending against insiders. The goal of "Ne-Trust" is to enable demonstrably better detection and more proactive defense against the evolving and increasingly complex insider threats to IT systems, thereby advancing beyond the Zero Trust model. The program is built upon the innovative concept of "Negative Trust" - a term related to Zero Trust, yet one that can also function as an independent designation for a distinct paradigm. While initial attempts to define "Negative Trust" have been made - for instance, in the context of deception technology - a comprehensive scientific and interdisciplinary examination of the term, aimed at establishing it as a standalone, evolved IT security paradigm, has yet to be conducted. Ne-Trust addresses precisely this gap, creating an opportunity for the first-ever scientific exploration and development of "negative-trust" architectures. In doing so, the Cyber ​​Agency opens the door to novel and disruptive research perspectives, providing early impetus for the cybersecurity paradigms and IT security architectures of the future - and beyond. This forward-looking vision - along with the potential for a quantum leap in the defensive capabilities of IT systems and the comprehensive examination of conceptual, technological, social, and legal issues - underscores both the ambitious and the high-risk nature of this research program.

description: Au titre de de sa compétence petite enfance, la Communauté d'Agglomération Provence Verte (CAPV) a en charge l'accueil de la petite enfance : création, aménagement et gestion des crèches, haltes garderies, relais des assistantes maternelles et autres structures d'accueil de la petite enfance. Le projet de la Direction de la Petite Enfance s'inscrit dans trois axes majeurs : - Une offre d'accueil diversifiée, de qualité et adaptée aux besoins des familles et des enfants - Un accompagnement à la parentalité - Un ancrage territorial des acteurs de la Petite Enfance. Le cadre national, résumé dans le projet de contrat, devra être appliqué par le délégataire. La CAPV a confié la gestion de service de dix établissements d'accueil du jeune enfant et d'un Relais Petite Enfance, à l'association " La Maison de l'Enfance Francis Barrau " dans le cadre d'un contrat de délégation de service public arrivant à échéance, après avenant, le 31 décembre 2027. A l'issue d'une analyse des modes de gestion, la CAPV a décidé, par la délibération en date du 25 septembre 2026 de retenir le principe du recours à la concession de service public pour l'exploitation de dix établissements d'accueil du jeune enfant et d'un relais petite enfance, à compter du 1er janvier 2028. Les prestations attendues dans le cadre de la concession sont indiquées dans le projet de contrat.

title: Kaupin yliopistollinen sosiaali- ja terveysasema pääurakka
description: Kaupin yliopistollinen sosiaali- ja terveysasema pääurakka Tämän hankintailmoituksen tarjouspyyntöön on päivitetty aiemman tarjouspyynnön virheellinen kirjaus tarjoajan liikevaihtovaatimuksesta. Samalla tarjouspyynnön määräaikoja on jatkettu 1 viikolla tarjouspyynnössä ilmoitetun mukaisesti. Tekniseen laskenta-aineistoon ei ole tehty muutoksia. Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialue valmistelee Kaupin yliopistollisen sosiaali- ja terveysaseman uudisrakennushanketta Tampereen yliopistollisen sairaalan Kaupin kampusalueelle. Kaupin yliopistollisen sote-aseman uudisrakennus (uusi C-rakennus) on n. 15 000 brm2:n (urakoinnin laajuus laskenta-asiakirjojen mukaan) laajuinen rakennus, johon sijoitetaan mm. terveysaseman vastaanottopalvelut, aikuisten sekä lasten- ja nuorten mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut, työikäisten sosiaalityö ja perheohjaus, avokuntoutus, suun terveydenhuolto, äitiys- ja lastenneuvola sekä kehitystä tukevat palvelut. Uusi C-rakennus rakennetaan Taysin Kaupin kampukselle nykyisten purettavien TAMKin rakennusten paikalle. Vanhat rakennukset puretaan ennen uudisrakennuksen urakan käynnistymistä. Uusi C-rakennus kytketään tunnelilla sairaala-alueen tunneliverkostoon ja ilmasillalla sairaalakampukseen sekä TAMKin olemassa olevaan ilmasiltaan. Hankkeen urakkamuoto on jaettu urakka. Tällä hankintailmoituksella haetaan hankkeelle rakennusurakoitsijaa, joka toimii hankkeessa myös pääurakoitsijana ja lainsäädännön tarkoittamana päätoteuttajana. Rakennustyöt on suunniteltu urakka-asiakirjojen mukaan alkavaksi ensisijaisesti kesäkuussa 2027, kuitenkin viimeistään syyskuussa 2027. Rakennusaikaa varataan 23 kuukautta. Hankkeen sivu-urakoitsijoita (putkiurakkaan, ilmanvaihtourakkaan, sammutusjärjestelmäurakkaan ja sähköurakkaan) haetaan toisella erillisellä hankintailmoituksella. Rakennusautomaatiourakoitsijana tulee toimimaan Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen puitesopimuskumppani. Tarjouslaskenta-aikaa annetaan noin kolme kuukautta.,

description: ----NOTICE OF CHANGES --- The solicitation number for this contract will be W912DR26RA034. Links to the correct SAM.GOV solicitation and Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module for the subject requirement will be posted to this presolicitation. The publicized release date for W912DR26RA034 solicitation is anticipated on/about 18 March 2026.---- THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY. This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP). No proposals are being solicited or accepted at this time. The Government is not liable for any costs incurred by interested parties in response to this notice. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District, intends to issue a solicitation for the design and construction of a new Component Rebuild Shop at Letterkenny Army Depot, Pennsylvania. This solicitation will be competed on an unrestricted basis. The Government intends to award a single Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract using a Two-Phase Design-Build to Budget (DBtB) approach aligning with selection procedures outlined in the Federal Acquisition Regulations. The scope includes demolition of an existing 16,700 GSF building and construction of a new facility containing vehicle repair bays, administrative offices, building support areas, and extensive site work including utilities, paving, and parking. The new facility of approximately 72,000 gross square feet (GSF) to support depot-level maintenance for various ground support and guided missile systems. The anticipated period of performance is 1,095 calendar days from Notice To Proceed. Pursuant to the nature of Design-Build procurement, the Government will not provide detailed construction plans. The successful offeror will be solely responsible for developing the design solution and for the professional integrity of the final design. Phase One (Request for Qualifications): The Government anticipates issuing the Phase One Request For Qualifications (RFQ) on or about 13 March 2026. This phase will be a qualifications-based competition to select a shortlist of the most highly qualified offerors. Phase Two: Shortlisted offerors will be issued a draft Request For Proposals (RFP) outlining the technical requirements for the project and will be invited to a series of one-on-one proprietary meetings in order to develop the final scope of work within the budget ceiling of $78,000,000. Upon completion of these meetings, a final RFP will be issued. Phase Two evaluations will be conducted in accordance with FAR Part 15, with an award based on a best value determination. This action will be subject to the Buy American statute. One or more of the items under this acquisition is subject to the World Trade Organization Government Procurement Agreement and Free Trade Agreements. NOTICE: This project is anticipated to have a Project Labor Agreement requirement. USACE requests any contractors who would like to provide any further feedback related to the DBtB acquisition strategy and any potential impacts, positive or otherwise to provide them via email to the POC listed in this pre-solicitation notice.

title: Switzerland – Engineering services – N01.20 MP-260003 - EP Weyermannshaus - Wankdorf - Projektverfasser BSA - Phase EK – PGV - (ID 12231)
description: La tangente urbaine de Berne compte parmi les tronçons de routes nationales les plus fréquentés. Entre 2008 et 2012, elle a fait l’objet d’une rénovation complète : les revêtements ont été remplacés et de nombreux objets d’inventaire ont été rénovés et renforcés. De plus, les mesures de protection contre le bruit ont été renforcées sur les tronçons concernés et adaptées aux exigences en vigueur à l’époque. Près de 15 ans se sont écoulés depuis, et l’état des couches de roulement s’est sensiblement détérioré. Ces dernières années, les dommages causés au revêtement se sont multipliés, ce qui a entraîné une augmentation des mesures d’entretien nécessaires à court terme (travaux mineurs du gros entretien). Des travaux de remplacement du revêtement (qui ne fait partie du mandat), à titre de mesure transitoire, ainsi qu’un projet de maintenance seront donc mis en œuvre dans le périmètre du projet. Celui-ci comprend les tronçons de routes nationales suivants : · N01.16 (jonction de Bethlehem – Forsthaus) · N01.20 (Forsthaus – échangeur de Wankdorf) · N06.32 (échangeur de Wankdorf – jonction de Wankdorf) · N12.84 (jonction de Bümpliz – échangeur de Weyermannshaus) Le présent appel d’offres porte sur les prestations d’auteur du projet EES pour le projet de maintenance, de la phase Concept global de maintenance à la procédure d’approbation des plans (PAP). Le projet sera élaboré selon la méthode de planification BIM. Description des prestations d’auteur du projet EES : · Projet de maintenance : du concept global de maintenance à la procédure d’approbation des plans (PAP) Au cours de la planification et la réalisation du remplacement du revêtement à titre de mesure provisoire (qui ne fait pas partie du mandat), il convient d’élaborer un concept global de maintenance pour le tronçon concerné. Sur la base des états des lieux qui doivent être effectués par le mandataire, il faut élaborer un concept global de maintenance, puis un concept d’intervention ou un projet de mise à l’enquête. Le mandataire accompagne le projet jusqu’à la procédure d’approbation des plans incluse (accompagnement de la procédure, traitement des oppositions). Au total, il s’agit de 146 objets d’inventaire répartis dans les domaines techniques suivants : - Tracé / Environnement (T/U) : 42 - Ouvrages d’art : 52 - Tunnel / Géotechnique (T/G) : 43 - EES : 3 - Objets tiers : 6

Първоначално планиранираният спектър може да бъде частично изменен, както и да се добавят нови продукти в хода на динамичната система. Количествата са ориентировъчни. Възложителят не e длъжен да изкупи посочените в спектъра количества. Одобрените кандидати могат да подадат оферта за една или повече единици, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП функционира на два етапа: Първи етап - събиране на заявления за участие и Втори етап - събиране на оферти по конкретни покани. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 15 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички заявления. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на три години, а именно в рамките на три години възложителят може да отправя покани до допуснатите кандидати за събиране на оферти за доставка на медицински изделия включени в първоначално планираният спектър или извън него. Слючените договори ще са със срок на действие: две години.

title: Ireland – Tree-maintenance services – DCC Multi-Party Framework Agreement for the Provision of Tree Care Services
description: The Framework Agreement covers the provision of tree surgery services to ensure that all trees under the care and management of Dublin City Council, including street trees and trees growing in parks and open spaces, are maintained in accordance with recognized arboricultural best practices and industry standards. The scope of services to be delivered under this Framework generally includes, but is not limited to, tree pruning operations such as crown reduction, limb pruning, crown lifting, and crown thinning, as well as tree felling and stump removal works. All services are intended to support the safe, sustainable, and effective management of the Council’s tree stock while promoting public safety, tree health, and environmental quality across the city. This Framework Agreement has been established to appoint suitably qualified and experienced economic operators who will be eligible to compete for individual work packages. The framework will be for 4 years. The framework will primarily be used by the Parks and Landscape Services Division, but may also be used by other divisions of Dublin City Council.. buyer: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF
title: Broad Agency Announcement - Development and Demonstration of Mine Safety and Health Technology
description: The goal of this solicitation is to accelerate the development, adaptation, evaluation, demonstration, and adoption of innovative technologies that improve the safety and health of mine workers across coal, metal, nonmetal, stone, sand, and gravel mining operations. NIOSH seeks applied research and technology-development efforts that have a credible pathway toward practical implementation in surface or underground mines. Of particular interest are projects that: 1) Advance promising prototype technologies toward mine-ready solutions, including final development, adaptation to challenging mining environments, modification to meet applicable permissibility requirements, and demonstration at mine sites. 2) Adapt technologies successfully used in other industries for mining applications, including necessary redesign, ruggedization, integration, permissibility modifications, performance evaluation, and in-mine demonstration. 3) Evaluate emerging or candidate technologies to determine their potential to improve mine worker safety and health, identify technical or operational barriers to implementation, and develop approaches for overcoming those barriers. 4) Facilitate adoption of mature safety and health technologies that are available but have not achieved widespread mining-industry implementation. Activities may include establishing initial operational capability through mine demonstrations, evaluating technology performance and usability, identifying barriers to adoption, and determining modifications needed for practical industry acceptance. 5) Conduct analyses that identify emerging hazards and future technology needs, including analysis of safety, health, injury, fatality, exposure, surveillance, operational, or other relevant data to inform future research and technology-development priorities.

title: (b26057-4) Affoltern a. A., Lindenmoosstrasse, étape 2, extension du Centre des collections du MNS / CFC 224
description:
Le Musée national suisse (MNS) abrite une collection unique de biens culturels suisses, couvrant une période allant de la préhistoire jusqu’à nos jours. Il met en valeur ce patrimoine de manière attrayante, tant pour le public suisse que pour les visiteurs internationaux, et assure la conservation, la préservation à long terme et l’étude scientifique des objets.

Le projet d’extension a pour objectif de rassembler, sur un seul site, les dépôts et installations existants, afin de répondre à la croissance continue des besoins en surfaces.

Ce nouveau bâtiment formera, avec les structures actuelles, un ensemble cohérent d’un point de vue architectural, fonctionnel et technique.

Pendant toute la durée du chantier, les bâtiments existants resteront en service. Des mesures appropriées donc être mises en place à l’intérieur du périmètre.

Le site du projet se trouve à proximité d’infrastructures sensibles (ligne à haute tension et voie ferrée) et dans une zone archéologique. Les travaux devront être réalisés avec un soin particulier, tant sur le plan de la sécurité que dans la gestion des contraintes techniques.

title: NMAH: 2027 Install Emergency Generator
description: The Smithsonian Institution (�Smithsonian�) is providing this Notice of a Pending Solicitation for the installation of emergency generator at National Museum of American History (NMAH) 1300 Constitution Ave NW, Washington, D.C., 20560. Note: This is a revised RFP. Do not use previous posted documents from SOL# 33330226RF0010007. The applicable North American Industry Classification Codes (�NAICS�) are: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction size standard is $45.0 million. 238210 � Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors size standard is $19.0 million. Construction Budget: Over $10M. Project Information: The purpose of the NMAH: Install Emergency Generator project is to replace an aging 300 kW diesel-fueled generator located on the museum�s lower level, which has exceeded its operational lifespan. This will be accomplished by furnishing and installing two (2) new 500kW natural gas-fueled generators, on the roof adjacent to the existing emergency generator. The project also includes all necessary work to support the installation, including routing a new natural gas line through the building, and performing all associated structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, security, hazardous material abatement, and architectural modifications required to ensure full functionality, seamless integration with existing systems, and future serviceability and maintenance. Specifically, work under this project includes but is not limited to: a. Install two (2) new natural gas powered 500kW generators with integral paralleling gear on a new rooftop structural steel platform. Convert existing collections storage space (Room 4606) to a new Emergency Electrical Room to contain a new switchboard, ATS�s, transformers and panelboards. Decommission and remove existing Diesel generator on lower level. b. Coordination between complex existing building which will remain fully operational and open to the public during the duration of the work and new electrical and gas service pathways throughout. c. Existing conditions documentation early in the construction phase for implementation into BIM models. d. Development of coordination and construction BIM models early in the construction phase that depict existing conditions and proposed service pathways to enable the short circuit Study. e. A short circuit study of the proposed project prior to equipment submittals. f. Protection of existing finishes in the areas of work. g. Installation of a new gas line throughout the building to the roof to serve the new generators, including a quality control in situ mock-up. h. Installation of new conduit, MI cabling, panelboards, and pull-boxes throughout the building. Removal of existing conduit, panelboards, and pull-boxes throughout the building. i. Working around existing IT/Fiber Optic within the 4th floor corridors to allow for new conduit installation. j. Two switchover events: One from existing to temporary emergency power supplies and one for temporary to new emergency power supplies. k. Reinforcement of existing structure to support the new generators. l. Removal of the existing diesel generator in the lower level. m. Testing for lead and asbestos on existing piping at new points of connection. n. Mechanical work in the lower level to provide new fuel oil pumps. o. Work within and adjacent to sensitive Collection Storage areas that will have access restrictions and will require security escort. p. Work within and adjacent to sensitive 5th floor spaces including the Library and the Director�s Suite. q. All work is within an operational Museum with both staff and the public present. r. Ceiling removals and installation on the 4th and 5th floors. s. Hot-work required to weld the gas and containment pipe sections, cutting of existing pipe, and heat producing hot applied roofing membrane. t. Erection of temporary construction safety barriers, dust and debris air filtration and localized welding fume extraction. u. title: Netherlands – Tools – Levering, keuring en onderhoud van gereedschappen en veiligheidsmiddelen
description: De opdracht omvat zowel de levering van magazijnartikelen als het uitvoeren van keuringen, inspecties, onderhouds- en beheertaken met betrekking tot diverse arbeidsmiddelen en veiligheidsmiddelen. Hieronder wordt meer context gegeven bij ieder onderdeel: Levering van magazijnartikelen: De leverancier draagt zorg voor de levering van standaard magazijnartikelen die door Oasen zijn voorzien van een artikelnummer. Hierbij gaat het onder meer om (elektrische) handgereedschappen, klein materiaal, huishoudelijke hulpmiddelen en overige veelgebruikte magazijnartikelen. Daarnaast wordt verwacht dat de leverancier op verzoek niet-standaard artikelen kan leveren die geen Oasen-artikelnummer hebben. Het betreft onder andere ladders, trappen, rolsteigers, veiligheidsmiddelen, aggregaten en andere hulpmiddelen die noodzakelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van werkzaamheden binnen de organisatie. Keuringen, inspecties en onderhoud: Alle inspecties, keuringen, onderhoudswerkzaamheden en bijbehorende registraties dienen te worden uitgevoerd conform de op dat moment geldende Europese en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, normen, richtlijnen en branchevoorschriften die van toepassing zijn op het betreffende arbeids- of veiligheidsmiddel. De leverancier is verantwoordelijk voor het toepassen van de juiste inspectie-, keurings- en onderhoudsregimes en stelt de frequentie daarvan vast op basis van wettelijke vereisten, gebruiksomstandigheden en een passende risicoafweging. De dienstverlening omvat onder meer het inspecteren, keuren, onderhouden, beheren en registreren van elektrische arbeidsmiddelen, klimmaterieel, valbeveiligingsmiddelen, hijsmiddelen, aggregaten en overige arbeidsmiddelen die door Oasen worden ingezet. Van de leverancier wordt verwacht dat deze relevante wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving, normen en richtlijnen actief volgt en zijn dienstverlening hierop aanpast. Tevens draagt de leverancier zorg voor een volledige en actuele registratie van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en verstrekt hij desgevraagd de daarbij behorende keuringsrapporten, certificaten en andere relevante documentatie. Beheer en onderhoud van aggregaten: De opdracht omvat tevens het uitvoeren van de vereiste jaarlijkse wettelijke keuring van aggregaten. Daarnaast is de leverancier verantwoordelijk voor het beheer, onderhoud en de registratie van deze middelen. Hierbij wordt gewerkt conform de geldende wet- en regelgeving, waaronder relevante ADR-richtlijnen en andere toepasselijke normen.

NAWCWD California Contracting/Acquisition/Procurement (CCAP) Industry Days Expo
description: The Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division (NAWCWD) will be participating in the California Contracting/Acquisition/Procurement (CCAP) Industry Days Expo, on February 9-10, 2027, at the Kerr McGee Center in Ridgecrest, CA. The 2027 CCAP Industry Days Expo is a two-day event that fosters interaction between Procurement and RDT&E personnel from NAWCWD China Lake and Point Mugu and industry leaders. The program is designed to help participating companies better understand the missions, priorities and future acquisition needs of NAWCWD. Government and industry representatives will exchange perspectives on contracting pathways, upcoming requirements, technical challenges and the capabilities needed to support the Warfighter. Throughout the event, attendees will have opportunities to: Engage directly with government acquisition, contracting, program and technical personnel. Learn about anticipated contracting requirements and areas of future mission demand. Introduce products, services, technologies and organizational capabilities to potential government and industry partners. Participate in open discussions focused on operational needs, innovation and potential solutions. Meet prime contractors and explore subcontracting, supplier and teaming opportunities. Connect with small businesses that offer complementary capabilities or specialized expertise. Visit industry and government exhibits to continue conversations in an informal, accessible setting. Build relationships with professionals from China Lake, Point Mugu and the broader defense and aerospace community. The CCAP experience emphasizes purposeful interaction. Participants are encouraged to arrive prepared to clearly communicate their capabilities, ask informed questions, identify potential partners and develop relationships that can continue beyond the event. Through a combination of presentations, exhibits, open dialogue and informal networking, CCAP 2027 will create an environment where government needs and industry capabilities can be better understood, aligned and advanced. Registration Information: Interested participants may find additional event details and register at: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2027-ccap-industry-days-expo-tickets-1993805976347 California Contracting/Acquisition/Procurement (CCAP) Industry Days Expo Event dates: February 9-10, 2027 Location: Kerr McGee Center in Ridgecrest, CA Note: NAWCWD is not the official hosts or sponsors of this event but are active participants. This Special Notice is for informational purposes only and shall not be considered as an invitation for bid, request for quotation, request for proposal, or as an obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any products or services.

title: Switzerland – Railways traffic-control equipment – PES Sicherungsanlagen
description: Die Sihltal Zürich Uetliberg Bahn SZU AG beabsichtigt im Rahmen des Programms ERTMS SZU (PES), die bestehenden Sicherungsanlagen zu erneuern und die Voraussetzungen für die Einführung der Führerstandssignalisierung auf Basis von ETCS Level 2 zu schaffen. Ausgangslage / installierte Basis Die SZU betreibt heute auf ihrem Netz bestehende Relaisstellwerke der Typen Do55, DoC, Do67 und Do69. Die bestehenden Anlagen sollen im Rahmen von PES durch eine moderne elektronische Sicherungsanlage mit ETCS Level 2 / RBC ersetzt werden. Das derzeitige SA-Konzept bildet die Planungsgrundlage für das Mengengerüst der zukünftigen Anlage. Der aktuelle Planungsstand umfasst voraussichtlich und approximativ insbesondere, aber nicht abschliessend: · 236 EHS; · 32 Bahnübergänge; · 74 Weichen; · 291 ETCS-Balisen; · 291 Achszähler / Gleisstromkreise, vor Berücksichtigung der teilweise erforderlichen Redundanz; · 233 Gleisfreimeldeabschnitte; · 59 ERS; · 11 Rangiertafeln; · 4 CAB-Tafeln. Das Mengengerüst entspricht dem aktuellen Stand der Planung und dient als Grundlage für die Angebotserstellung. Es kann im Rahmen der weiteren Projektierung und Systemoptimierung angepasst werden. Das detaillierte Mengengerüst sowie die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung und im SA-Konzept beschrieben. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung / Grundauftrag Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist als Grundauftrag die Planung, Lieferung, Integration, Prüfung, Inbetriebnahme, Instandhaltung und Dokumentation der für die Einführung von ETCS Level 2 erforderlichen elektronischen Stellwerke sowie des Radio Block Centre (RBC). Die ausgeschriebenen Kernsysteme sind als integrierte Gesamtlösung zu realisieren und in die bestehende sowie zukünftige Systemlandschaft der SZU einzubinden. Der Lieferant übernimmt innerhalb der definierten Systemgrenzen die technische und funktionale Integrationsverantwortung. Dies umfasst insbesondere die Integration von Stellwerk und RBC sowie die Koordination und Sicherstellung der definierten Schnittstellen zu angrenzenden Systemen und Leistungen. title: Rio De Flag - Phase 4 Construction
description: SOLICITATION W912PL27BA001: RIO DE FLAG FLOOD CONTROL PROJECT - PHASE 4 CONSTRUCTION (LOWER RDF INLET) PRODUCT SERVICE CODE (PSC): Y1KB - CONSTRUCTION OF CANALSISSUING ACTIVITY: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Los Angeles District (SPL) 1. GENERAL PROCUREMENT OVERVIEW: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Los Angeles District, is issuing this Invitation for Bids (IFB) to award a single, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) construction contract for Phase 4 (Lower RDF Inlet) of the Rio De Flag Flood Control Project in Flagstaff, Coconino County, Arizona.- Procurement Type: Invitation for Bids (IFB) conducted pursuant to FAR Part 14 and FAR Part 36 (Sealed Bidding).- Competition: Unrestricted / Full and Open Competition.- Mandatory Classification Code (PSC): Y1KB - Construction of Canals.- NAICS Code: 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction (Small Business Size Standard: $45.0 Million).- Estimated Construction Magnitude: Between $35,000,000.00 and $50,000,000.00 (FAR 36.204).- Period of Performance: 1,095 calendar days from issuance of Notice to Proceed (NTP), which includes anticipated seasonal winter shutdowns during December and January.- Solicitation Release Date: On or about 4 December 2026.- Public Virtual Bid Opening: On or about 11 February 2027. 2. DETAILED PROJECT SCOPE AND ENGINEERING FEATURES: The Rio De Flag Flood Control Project is a vital flood risk management initiative in partnership with the City of Flagstaff (Non-Federal Sponsor) designed to manage and convey 100-year (1 percent Annual Exceedance Probability [AEP]) flood discharges from Upper Rio De Flag and Clay Avenue Wash through downtown Flagstaff into the Lower Rio De Flag channel. Phase 4 involves heavy civil, structural, and environmental construction in a dense, historic urban and active railroad corridor. Major components include:- Flood Conveyance Infrastructure: Construction across an adjusted alignment limit of approximately 4,950.58 linear feet (LF), featuring: -- 1,995 LF of Reinforced Concrete Box (RCB) culverts (single and multiple-barrel sections). -- 2,555.08 LF of riprap-lined earthen trapezoidal channel (9-inch and 21-inch stone revetment). -- 200 LF of grouted stone channel, 100.5 LF of reinforced concrete transition structures, and 100 LF of rectangular concrete channel. -- Concrete wingwalls, drop inlets, junction structures, side drainage connections (18-inch to 60-inch RCP), and outlet headwalls.- Earthwork and Controlled Rock Blasting: Mass soil excavation (approx. 85,000 plus CY), soft rock excavation (approx. 27,000 plus CY), and hard basalt rock excavation (approx. 21,000 plus CY). Hard rock excavation requires precision line drilling, specialized shoring, and controlled blasting under stringent vibration thresholds.- Active Railway Corridor Coordination: Culvert construction occurs within 15 feet of active Burlington Northern Santa Fe (BNSF) Railway mainline tracks and historic downtown structures. Real-time automated geotechnical monitoring (vibration/PPV, tiltmeters, ground settlement, inclinometers, and piezometers) and strict compliance with a mandatory BNSF License Agreement are required. Work also includes relocation of the San Francisco Street BNSF signal bungalow.- Environmental Remediation: Excavation, testing, handling, and off-site disposal of petroleum-contaminated soils, and decommissioning/removal of underground storage tanks (USTs) in historic downtown locations (including former Paramount, Fuel Bunkers, Creosote, and 5 Points sites).- Civil and Utility Support: Surface water diversion and control, complex groundwater dewatering (water tables 5 to 20 feet below pre-excavation surface), extensive City of Flagstaff utility relocations (water, sanitary sewer, storm drainage), street restoration, traffic control, security fencing, automated irrigation systems, exterior plantings, and a mandatory 12-month plant establishment period. 3. SUMMARY OF IFB / SEALED BIDDING PROCEDURES:- Unit Price CLIN Schedule: Bids must be submitted against established Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs) as detailed in Section 00 10 00.- No Post-Bid Negotiations: Award will be made without discussions or negotiations pursuant to FAR 14.101 and FAR 14.408. Bids must conform in all respects to the solicitation instructions.- Virtual Bid Opening: Bids will be publicly unsealed and read aloud virtually. Specific platform login and dial-in instructions will be detailed in Section 00 21 13 and any subsequent amendments.- Basis of Award: Award will be made to the lowest-priced responsive and responsible bidder. 4. MANDATORY REGISTRATION AND WEB-ONLY DISTRIBUTION:THE GOVERNMENT INTENDS TO ISSUE THIS SOLICITATION AND ALL AMENDMENTS THROUGH THE USE OF THE INTERNET (WEB ONLY). No additional media (CD-ROMs, floppy disks, faxes, or paper copies) will be provided unless deemed necessary by the Government.- SAM.gov Access: Viewing and downloading documents requires an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://sam.gov/content/home.- First-Time Users: Registration requires a SAM Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), active SAM registration, Marketing Partner Identification Number (MPIN), CAGE Code, and official email address.- Subcontractor Requirements: ALL prospective prime contractors and subcontractors wishing to access solicitation files must maintain an active SAM profile.- Active Registration at Award: Offerors must maintain an active SAM registration to be eligible for award (FAR 52.204-7). For Joint Ventures (JVs), the JV entity itself must have a valid SAM registration representing the joint entity.- Electronic Invoicing: Contract payment processing will be conducted electronically through PIEE / Wide Area WorkFlow (WAWF) under DFARS 252.232-7006.- Point of Entry Responsibility: It is the sole responsibility of prospective offerors to monitor https://sam.gov/content/home and PIEE frequently for any solicitation notices, files, amendments, or schedule modifications. This procurement may be delayed, canceled, or revised at any time. 5. STATUTORY AND REGULATORY HIGHLIGHTS:- Limitations on Subcontracting (FAR 52.219-14): Small businesses are reminded that under FAR 52.219-14, the prime contractor will not pay more than 85 percent of the amount paid by the Government for contract performance to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities (excluding material costs). Any work that a similarly situated entity further subcontracts will count towards the 85 percent subcontract limitation.- Subcontracting Plans (FAR 52.219-9 / DFARS 252.219-7003): Unrestricted large businesses must submit an acceptable Small Business Subcontracting Plan.- Bid Guarantee (FAR 52.228-1): A bid guarantee is required in the amount of 20 percent of the bid price or $3,000,000.00, whichever is less.- Performance and Payment Bonds (FAR 52.228-15): 100 percent penal amount for both Performance (SF 25) and Payment (SF 25A) bonds within 10 days of award.- Project Labor Agreement (FAR 52.222-33 / FAR 52.222-34): Executive Order 14063 policies apply to large-scale federal construction projects of $35 Million or greater.- Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (DFARS 252.204-7025): Bidders must possess at least a CMMC Level 1 (Self) assessment entered in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) prior to award.- Prevailing Wages (FAR 52.222-6): Mandatory compliance with Davis-Bacon Construction Wage Rate Requirements. 6. title: Ireland – Road construction works – Foynes to Limerick Road (including Adare Bypass) – Croagh to Rathkeale Design and Construction Contract
description: Limerick City and County Council (LCCC) is seeking tenders for the Foynes to Limerick Road (including Adare Bypass) – Croagh to Rathkeale Design and Construction Contract, which will be procured under the NEC4 Option C form of Contract. The Croagh to Rathkeale Design and Construction Contract includes but is not limited to: 5.0 km of mainline carriageway (M21 Motorway), 2.75 km of mainline carriageway (N69 Type 2 Dual Carriageway), 0.65 km of mainline carriageway (N21 Type 1 Single Carriageway), 3.1 km of sideroads (approx.), 3.2 km of access tracks (approx.), Various structures (excluding specific mammal and bat underpasses), 10 No. attenuation ponds and various retaining walls. The Croagh to Rathkeale Design and Construction Contract forms part of Sections C and D of the wider Foynes to Limerick Road (Including Adare Bypass) Project. At its eastern extent, the Contract ties into the Adare Bypass in the townland of Croagh, which is currently under construction. At its western extent, it ties into the existing N21 in the townland of Rathkeale. To the north, the scheme terminates at the R518/L1222 junction in the townland of Graigeen where the future Foynes to Rathkeale element of the project will connect. A variety of Advance Works / Enabling Works have been undertaken on the site of the Foynes to Limerick Road (including Adare Bypass) – Croagh to Rathkeale Design and Construction Contract including fencing, hedge clearance, haul roads, access tracks, accommodation works, utility diversions and earthworks. The above paragraphs are a summary only and Tenderers are directed to read and formulate their Tenders based on all of the provisions of the Contract as detailed in the Tender Documents that can be found here on eTenders and in the Virtual Data Room (VDR).

title: 13785 / 285-02 Restaurator, Kirche Grossmünster, Instandsetzung + Optimierung
description:
285-02 Restaurator

Konservatorische Massnahmen und Spezielreinigung zur Sicherung der historischen Malereien in Krypta, Zwölfbotenkapelle und Chor des Grossmünsters.


Das Grossmünster zählt zu den bedeutendsten Baudenkmälern der Schweiz und ist ein Wahrzeichen der Stadt Zürich. Im Rahmen eines mehrjährigen Gesamtprojekts werden die historische Bausubstanz instandgesetzt und die Infrastruktur für den Kirchenbetrieb und die touristische Nutzung optimiert.

Teilprojekt A umfasst die dringlichen und konservatorischen Instandsetzung im Innenraum. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung sind die noch ausstehenden Konservierungs- und Restaurierungsarbeiten an den historischen Wandmalereien im Chor, in der Krypta und in der Zwölfbotenkapelle. Die Arbeiten umfassen eine vorgelagerte Evaluationsphase zur Festlegung der

erforderlichen Massnahmen sowie deren anschliessende Ausführung und Dokumentation. Ziel ist der langfristige Erhalt der historischen Wandmalereien unter Berücksichtigung der denkmalpflegerischen Anforderungen.

title: Brand Name National Stock Numbers: Industry Feedback Request
description: GSA's Supply Chain Management Contracting Division is seeking feedback from industry regarding the Brand Name National Stock Numbers (NSNs) published with this notice. The NSNs were established as Brand Name (BN) specific at the point they were created, and therefore the Item Purchase Descriptions (IPDs) are likewise written as BN specific. Supporting information was provided at the point of NSN/IPD creation, however in some cases that information may no longer be relevant (see FAR Part 10), and as Brand Name specific items, GSA is seeking to verify whether the need described by the IPDs can in fact only be met by the one particular manufacturer cited (the manufacturer indicated in the IPD), or whether other manufacturers� products (or brands) can be offered which can meet the requirement. In order to meet the continued need for these items on behalf of our customers, GSA will seek to add these items to contract, but during the lifecycle of the NSN, we are issuing this notice as a request to industry to provide feedback confirming or countering the requirement as described. Are these manufacturer names and part numbers, as listed in the IPDs, the only manufacturers that will meet the requirement, or are there suitable substitute manufacturer names and part numbers that can be offered to meet the requirement? Please note that supporting information must be provided by industry respondents by filling in accurately and completely, all of the designated columns, for any NSN(s) that you are seeking to comment on. To respond to this feedback request, please complete the attached excel template in the highlighted columns designated for industry feedback, along with supporting documentation for all NSNs where you indicated a viable substitute, and email them to fssi.mro-req@gsa.gov. Note that all literature must contain the NSN indicated on every page of literature submitted so that the NSN association being made is clear. Also the subject line of your email must follow this naming convention: BN NSN Industry Feedback, [Your Vendor or OEM Name]. ie, "BN NSN Industry Feedback, ABC Corporation". All NSNs with corresponding Brand Name Only manufacturer and part numbers are listed on the Brand Name attachment. To request an individual IPD, please email fssi.mro-req@gsa.gov with the following naming convention in the subject: �BN NSN Industry Feedback, IPD Request, NSN (please list NSN)� The Government will not review or consider submissions concerning NSNs that are currently included on the AbilityOne Procurement List. Such NSNs are outside the scope of this RFI. The Government will not consider submissions that rely on proprietary, export-controlled, or otherwise restricted technical data the respondent is not legally authorized to use or disclose. Respondents must ensure that all submitted information was lawfully obtained and may be provided to the Government. Please note that this is a continuous RFI, submissions can be received at anytime during the life of the RFI.

title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: GreenFuran Direct Allylation
description: A mild, biomass-friendly route to allylated furans Manufacturers who depend on alkyl and allylic furans can now reach these valuable ingredients through a single, low-waste step that trades cryogenic equipment, hazardous reagents and costly precious metals for gentle heating and cheap, recyclable catalysts. The GreenFuran Direct Allylation method developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory feeds on renewable, biomass-derived alcohols, produces only water as a byproduct and lifts away the catalyst by simple filtration, so operators gain a cleaner process, an easier cleanup and lower input costs at the same time. Crucially, the reaction succeeds on substituted and even multiply substituted furans that older approaches simply could not convert, opening a wider palette of products from one dependable platform. The Challenge The established ways to make alkyl furans � chiefly ortho-lithiation, Friedel-Crafts alkylation or transition-metal-catalyzed C-H functionalization � each carry serious burdens when moved beyond the bench. Ortho-lithiation demands cryogenic temperatures and pyrophoric organolithium reagents that ignite on contact with air, while Friedel-Crafts routes consume stoichiometric quantities of Lewis acids that generate large volumes of waste and complicate cleanup and metal-catalyzed methods rely on expensive metals and ligands and inaccessible starting materials. Problems Solved GreenFuran Direct Allylation answers each of those burdens with a single dehydrative reaction that couples furans and allylic alcohols directly, eliminating the separate prefunctionalization step and its associated waste while yielding only water as the byproduct. The process runs under mild conditions, needing just ambient conditions or gentle heating up to 60 degrees Celsius, and it uses simple, inexpensive and environmentally benign catalysts including aluminosilicates and metal phosphates. The solid catalyst separates cleanly by filtration or decanting, removing the difficult workup common to older routes, and the allylic alcohols themselves can be drawn from renewable feedstocks. Most importantly, the method extends reliably to substituted and polysubstituted furans bearing alkyl, aryl and fused-aryl groups as well as esters, aldehydes and ketones, reaching the very targets earlier methods could not. Advantages � Mild, safer operation that avoids cryogenic cooling and hazardous, air-sensitive reagents � Inexpensive, environmentally friendly catalysts that can be removed and recovered by simple filtration � Renewable, biomass-derived starting materials such as prenol, geraniol and phytol � Only water is produced as a byproduct, cutting waste and easing cleanup � One fewer synthetic step, because no separate preparation of the alcohol is needed � Broad reach across simple and complex furans that older methods could not convert Market Applications � Food and Beverage (flavoring agents and additives) � Personal Care and Cosmetics (fragrance and cosmetic ingredients) � Chemicals (surfactants for industrial and consumer formulations) � Agriculture and Pest Control (insecticide ingredients) TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-27238 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. title: Belgium – Engineering design services – Studieopdracht Pelt, Nolimpark
description: De opdracht betreft het ontwerp van een riolering- en wegenisproject (R&W), opvolging, veiligheidscoördinatie en de opmaak van proefverslagen, zoals verder beschreven in hoofdstukken 2 en 3 van dit bestek voor het project te Pelt Nolimpark. Het project “Pelt – Nolimpark” vormt technisch, functioneel en hydraulisch één samenhangend geheel. Om een gefaseerde en beheersbare verdere uitwerking en uitvoering mogelijk te maken, werd de volledige projectzone administratief en boekhoudkundig opgedeeld in vier zones/fasen, waaraan afzonderlijke projectnummers werden toegekend: - R/004302 – Pelt, Nolimpark fase 1 - R/007561 – Pelt, Nolimpark fase 2 - R/007562 – Pelt, Nolimpark fase 3 - R/007563 – Pelt Niolimpark fase 4 Deze opdeling doet evenwel geen afbreuk aan de onderlinge samenhang van de verschillende zones. De opdrachtnemer dient de volledige projectzone, bestaande uit de vier fasen, als één geïntegreerd geheel te bestuderen en te ontwerpen tot en met de goedkeuring van het ontwerp. Bij de uitwerking dient rekening te worden gehouden met de onderlinge technische, hydraulische en functionele afhankelijkheden tussen de verschillende fasen. Tot deze globale ontwerpbenadering behoren eveneens: • de opmaak en begeleiding van de subsidiedossiers met betrekking tot de fietspaden voor fase 1, fase 2 en fase 3; • de aanpassing en verdere uitwerking van de hydraulische nota voor de volledige projectzone, onder meer in functie van het beperken van de bemaling van vervuild grondwater; De goedkeuring van het geïntegreerde ontwerp houdt niet automatisch de opdracht in om alle vier de fasen onmiddellijk verder uit te werken tot aanbestedings- en uitvoeringsniveau. De verdere uitwerking van de afzonderlijke fasen gebeurt overeenkomstig de fasering en timing bepaald door de aanbestedende overheid en, voor zover van toepassing, na afzonderlijke opdracht of kennisgeving hiertoe. De opdrachtnemer dient hiermee rekening te houden in zijn aanpak, planning en organisatie van de opdracht. De verdere detaillering van een fase mag daarbij geen afbreuk doen aan de uitgangspunten en randvoorwaarden van het goedgekeurde geïntegreerde ontwerp voor de volledige projectzone.

description: PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: The Department of Veterans Affairs, National Cemetery Administration intends to issue a solicitation entitled, Cemetery Expansion and Improvement Project, Project # 926CM3010, at the Washington Crossing National Cemetery, on or about December 20, 2026, unless additional notice is given, or this notice is modified or cancelled, the full solicitation, specifications and drawings will be posted on Contract Opportunities at beta.sam.gov. Project will include, but not limited to, extensive excavation, grading, stormwater and utility infrastructure, roads, curbs, paving, irrigation and controls, columbarium construction, manufacturing and installation of approximately 8,500 pre-placed crypt units, and repairs/renovations to the Public Information Center and maintenance building. The acquisition type for this solicitation will be Request for Proposal IAW FAR 15.101-1: Tradeoff Process. Per VAAR 836.204 Disclosure of the magnitude of construction projects, the construction magnitude for this requirement is between $10,000,000 and $20,000,000. A date will be published in the solicitation. This procurement is 100% Set-Aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) concerns. title: M231/M232A2, Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) Load, Assemble, and Pack (LAP)
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command � Rock Island at Picatinny (ACC-RI-PICA), Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey 07806-5000, on behalf of the Office of the Project Manager for Combat Ammunition Systems (PM CAS), intends to issue competitive Request for Proposal (RFP) for the manufacture, Load, Assemble, and Pack (LAP), and final delivery of the 155MM M231 and M232 TYPE Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) Propelling Charges. The MACS M231/M232 Type LAP meets the U.S. Army�s requirements for 155mm artillery propelling charges that are critical for and compatible with all existing 155mm artillery weapons systems and compliant with the Joint Ballistic memorandum of understanding. The 155mm M231/M232 MACS provides U.S. field artillery with a less-sensitive improved solid propelling charge system for use with current and future 155mm howitzer systems. The MACS is an evolution of the XM230 Unicharge, which was developed as a replacement for the family of four separate bag charges for the 155mm cannon artillery systems. The Unicharge was intended to be a single increment universal charge module that would provide needed zoning solutions for both 39-caliber and Extended Range Ordnance Assembly cannons by building up the charge. The MACS is currently a two-charge propellant system that offers improvement in operational flexibility, performance, logistic support, and cost when compared to the previous generation of bag propelling charges. The MACS LAP consists of two types of propelling charges, the M231 and the M232 TYPE, and all associated packaging. It uses a "build-a-charge," incremental-based system; the M231 is used singularly or in pairs for Low Zones (1 & 2) and the M232-Series is used in groups of 3, 4 or 5 charges for High Zones (3, 4 & 5). The system is compatible with all current 155mm field artillery weapons. The total maximum contract value will be $2,586,684,823.02, to include all contract awards, to procure up to an estimated 3,544,182 M231 and an estimated 15,000,000 M232 TYPE propelling charges. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database by accessing the SAM web site at http://www.sam.gov to be eligible for contract award and all correspondence must be in English. Estimated time for release of the solicitation is Quarter 2, FY27 (Q2FY27). However, if any interested sources intend to review, respond, and/or submit a response to the formal Solicitation; a DRAFT Solicitation is readily available to be provided via DOD SAFE, upon request. The MACS LAP of the 155mm M231 and the M232 TYPE Propelling Charges will be in accordance with Government Technical Data Packages (TDPs). The TDPs are coded as Distribution Statement D (Further Distribution authorized to the Department of War (DoW) and U.S. DoD contractors only. Other requests for this document must be referred to the controlling DoW office: PM CAS) and will be made available once the Solicitation has been released for this effort. A completed Military Critical Technical Data Agreement (AMSTA-AR Form 1350), and a completed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) will be required prior to consideration to receiving the TDP. The POCs for any questions, DRAFT Solicitation, or the TDP request, this notification, and any requests/questions may be directed to Ms. Arian Sommers, at arian.r.sommers.civ@army.mil and Ms. Jennifer Hughes, at jennifer.m.hughes56.civ@army.mil. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted.

title: Simulator Collection for Atomic to Continuum Scales (SCACS)
description: Engineers designing semiconductors, fusion reactors, spacecraft and advanced electronics need to know how heat and electricity will move through materials, at every microscopic location where a defect, grain boundary or interface could trigger failure. SCACS, developed by scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory, delivers that insight by connecting two worlds that have long been disconnected: the atomic-scale physics that governs true material behavior and the continuum-scale engineering models used to design real devices. Built on novel atomic-site-projected conductivity methods and accelerated through graph neural networks, SCACS predicts spatially varying, direction-dependent thermal and electrical transport across large million-atom systems, giving material design Engineers a physics-grounded view of where hot-spots will form in materials, how defects will steer current and which microstructural choices will make or break performance. Overview The SCACS Toolkit is an AI-driven multiscale simulation platform designed to accelerate the development and deployment of advanced materials. Today, materials innovation is slowed by a fundamental gap: High-fidelity physics models (e.g., molecular dynamics) are too computationally expensive for real-world design, while the engineering-scale tools rely on simplified assumptions that limit predictive accuracy. This disconnect leads to costly trial-and-error development cycles and unexpected material failures in critical systems. SCACS bridges this gap by embedding machine-learned physics directly into engineering-scale simulations. Its core technology uses proprietary models Site-Projected Thermal Conductivity (SPTC-AI) and Site-Projected Electronic Conductivity (SPEC-AI) to translate first-principles insights into spatially resolved transport properties that can be used within standard finite element workflows. This approach enables accurate prediction of heat and electrical behavior in complex, heterogeneous materials at practical scales. The platform has broad commercial relevance across industries where thermal and electrical performance are critical, including semiconductors, energy systems, and advanced manufacturing. By reducing development time, improving reliability and lowering testing costs, SCACS offers a pathway to faster material qualification and more efficient product design, positioning it as a high-impact enabling technology for next-generation hardware innovation. Technology Description At its core, SCACS is a computational suite that links atomistic simulations to continuum finite-element models through two integrated modules: SPTC-AI for thermal transport and SPEC-AI for electronic transport. The Site-Projected Thermal Conductivity (SPTC) and Space-Projected Electronic Conductivity (SPEC) methods decompose a material�s bulk conductivity into per-atom contributions, revealing how individual phases, defects and interfaces locally steer the flow of heat or charge. A machine-learning graph neural network then learns these atomic-scale contributions from a curated training set and scales the predictions up to representative volume elements suitable for finite-element analysis. The companion solver modules called sptc2fem and spec2fem, built on FEniCSx, ingests the resulting thermal and electronic conductivity fields, respectively, and produces temperature/current maps, heat-flux/current density distributions and direction-resolved effective conductivities under realistic boundary conditions. This result preserves the atomic-scale anisotropy upstream that other methods would wash out. The end-to-end workflow delivers atomistic fidelity at device-relevant length scales. HPC runtimes drop from days to seconds, hot-spots and localized transport pathways become visible at the design stage, and engineers can interrogate how microstructural features will influence thermal and electrical performance before a single component is fabricated. By coarse-graining atom-resolved conductivity into spatially varying fields rather than collapsing them to a single bulk value, the technology preserves the heterogeneity, interfaces and defect populations that conventional finite-element treatments tend to hide behind an averaged scalar input. Advantages Reveals localized hot-spots and transport pathways that conventional continuum models routinely miss Cuts simulation runtimes from days on high-performance computing clusters down to minutes, without sacrificing atomic-scale fidelity Scales predictions from small atomistic cells up to million-atom microstructures previously out of reach for direct atomistic methods Captures anisotropy and spatial variation in both thermal and electrical conductivity, giving engineers a directionally accurate picture of material behavior Easily integrates with exiting finite-element solvers, such as Abaqus Market Applications Semiconductor advanced packaging (3D integrated circuits, chiplet thermal management, package reliability analysis) Fusion energy systems (divertor and first-wall plasma-facing components, refractory metal joining qualification) Aerospace and space systems (spacecraft thermal analysis, radiation-exposed materials, mission reliability modeling) Computer-aided engineering software (constitutive model inputs for industry-standard simulation platforms) Battery and energy storage (thermal management of cells, modules and packs) Thermoelectrics and biosensors (materials discovery, device-level transport characterization) Quantum device manufacturing (cryogenic cooling design, qubit thermal isolation) Related Software T5032 - SCACS is a physics-informed ML, graph neural network trained on atomic site-resolved SPTC data, enabling transfer of atomic-scale physics to device-scale modeling. title: Autonomous Ion Mass Spectrometer Sentry (AIMSS)
description: Satellite measurements of plasma density and temperature help predict the intensity of geomagnetic storms, which can impact satellites, communications, and power systems. Accurate forecasting requires knowledge of plasma composition. However, typical orbital mass spectrometers have difficulty distinguishing between nitrogen (N+) and oxygen (O+) ions due to their similar masses. This limitation makes it difficult to validate modern space weather models, which depend on accurate knowledge of ion composition in near-Earth space. N+ and O+ ions behave differently in space due to differences in their origin, transport, and loss mechanisms. Improving our ability to distinguish between these ions is critical for understanding and predicting space weather. Advantages High mass resolution enables distinction between ion species that are typically unresolved in space-based measurements (e.g., N+ vs O+) Simultaneous measurement of multiple ion species for improved data collection efficiency Commandable ion throughput allows for high dynamic range without detector saturation Flight-qualified design with near-term on-orbit demonstration on the ISS Technology Description The AIMSS instrument uses electric and magnetic fields to sort ions first by energy and then by mass. As ions move through the instrument, different species are separated and spread out across the detector as a spectrum, similar to how a prism separates white light into different colors. First, incoming ions pass through two electrostatic energy filters (ESAs) located at the front of the sensor. These filters allow only ions within a selected energy range to continue through the instrument. By adjusting the voltage applied to each filter, AIMSS can control how many ions reach the detector and adapt to changing plasma density. Next, the ions enter a magnetic field section that separates them by mass. Lighter ions are deflected more than heavier ions, causing different ion species to land at different positions on the detector. The detector records where ions land, allowing the instrument to measure multiple ion species at once and determine their mass and energy. This design achieves clear separation of closely spaced ion species such as N+ and O+, improving the accuracy of plasma composition measurements. Market Applications AIMSS supports both scientific and operational markets: Space Domain Awareness: ?Monitoring plasma density and composition to attribute spacecraft anomalies and charging events. Space Weather Monitoring and Forecasting?: Ion composition measurements of ionospheric plasma to inform space weather models and improve forecasting. Space Station Operations for Lunar and Mars Missions?: Monitoring spacecraft health, contamination, and charging during extravehicular activities (EVAs) and docking operations. Department of Defense / Space Force?: Compliance with requirements for onboard space environment sensors. title: Netherlands – Road traffic-control equipment – Raamovereenkomst leveren verkeersregeltoestellen Gemeente Breda
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht De werkzaamheden in het kader van de levering van verkeersregeltoestellen bestaan in hoofdzaak uit: Het leveren van verkeersregeltoestellen. Het aanpassen van verkeersregeltoestellen welke zijn geleverd volgens deze raamovereenkomst. Het onderhouden van de geleverde verkeersregeltoestellen. Het up to date houden van de geleverde verkeersregeltoestellen. Voor een volledig overzicht van de werkzaamheden verwijzen wij u naar de RAW-Raamovereenkomst die als bijlage in Mercell is bijgevoegd. Buiten scope Het realiseren van verkeersregelinstallaties en aansluiten van verkeersregeltoestellen op straat valt buiten de scope van deze opdracht. Dit geldt eveneens voor de ketencoördinatie gedurende de onderhoudsfase. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de levering van deze diensten een raamovereenkomst af te sluiten met twee (2) opdrachtnemers met een looptijd van twee (2) jaar met als ingangsdatum 15 mei 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze drie (3) maal met twee (2) jaar te verlengen. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestatie. Daarmee is de totale mogelijke doorlooptijd acht jaar. Gemeente Breda kiest er bewust voor om de mogelijke looptijd te verlengen tot acht jaar. Dit heeft meerdere redenen: Een verkeersregeltoestel is een complex technisch systeem en de duurste component van een verkeersregelinstallatie. Gemeente Breda stelt specifieke eisen aan de leverantie en de prestaties van een opdrachtnemer. Door de looptijd voldoende ruim te kiezen biedt gemeente Breda leveranciers voldoende afzet om een zo goed mogelijk product te leveren. Door de doorlooptijd voldoende ruim te kiezen kan gemeente Breda bouwen aan de samenwerking met de opdrachtnemer. Deze looptijd biedt namelijk de mogelijkheid voor het maken van goede (werk)afspraken, die geoptimaliseerd worden gedurende de looptijd op basis van geleerde lessen. Binnen de markt van verkeersregeltoestellen zijn op dit moment maximaal drie leveranciers aanwezig. Daarmee is de kans dat bij een nieuwe aanbesteding dezelfde leverancier(s) de aanbesteding wint realistisch. Gemeente Breda wil voorkomen dat om de paar jaar voorbereidingskosten worden gemaakt waarbij de kans groot is dat een zelfde partij de aanbesteding weer wint. Deze raamovereenkomst sluit aan op landelijke standaarden met betrekking tot de aanschaf van verkeersregeltoestellen. Updates van deze verkeersregeltoestellen worden meegenomen via het onderhoud, waarvoor gemeente Breda gebonden is aan de leverancier. Daarmee worden geen grootschalige technische innovaties verwacht binnen de looptijd van deze overeenkomst. De looptijd kan dan ook ruimer worden gehanteerd. Maximale contractwaarde [indien raamovereenkomst] De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 5.000.000,- (excl. BTW) bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties, vermeerderd met een onzekerheidsmarge van 50%. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Er kunnen, incidenteel, redenen zijn om een specifiek toestel bij een specifieke contractant uit te vragen. Bijvoorbeeld in het geval van een streng of een uitbreiding van een streng verkeersregelinstallaties. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst van rechtswege eindigen. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Henkilökohtaisen avun ja muiden kotona asumista tukevien palveluiden hankinta dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä
description: Tällä osallistumispyynnöllä perustetaan sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä. Palvelun tilaajana on Keski-Uudenmaan sote-kuntayhtymä, johon kuuluvat Hyvinkään ja Järvenpään kaupungit sekä Mäntsälän, Nurmijärven, Pornaisten ja Tuusulan kunnat. Hankintajärjestelmässä hankinnan kohteena on henkilökohtaisen avun palvelut, tukihenkilöpalvelut ja vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyö. Hankinnan kohde ja hankintajärjestelmän toiminta on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet. Palvelut on tarkoitettu Keski-Uudenmaan sote-kuntayhtymän asiakkaille, joilla on vammaisuuteen tai pitkäaikaissairauteen liittyvä tuen tarve. Palveluntuottajat voivat hakeutua hankintajärjestelmään perustamisvaiheessa ja myöhemmin sen voimassaoloaikana jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen osallistumispyynnön mukaisesti. Hankintayksikkö varaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän perustamisvaiheessa 25.3.2021 klo 10.00 mennessä saapuneiden osallistumishakemusten käsittelyyn 15 työpäivää. Hankintayksikkö lähettää ensimmäisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen tarjouspyynnön luokassa 1 Henkilökohtaisen avun palvelut. Palvelun sisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä Palvelukuvaus Henkilökohtaisen avun palvelut. Tarjouspyyntö lähetetään vasta kun ainakin kaikki edellä ilmoitettuun määräaikaan mennessä saapuneet osallistumishakemukset on käsitelty. Osallistumishakemukset perustamisvaiheessa tulee jättää 25.3.2021 klo 10.00 mennessä. Luokka 1 Henkilökohtaisen avun palvelut Hankinnan kohteena on henkilökohtaisen avun palvelu. Henkilökohtaisen avun palvelu perustuu vammaispalvelulain (380/1987) 8 § (vammaisille tarkoitetut palvelut), 8 c § (henkilökohtainen apu) ja 8 d §:ään (henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämistavat). Henkilökohtaisella avulla tarkoitetaan tässä laissa vaikeavammaisen henkilön välttämätöntä avustamista kotona ja kodin ulkopuolella päivittäisissä toimissa, työssä ja opiskelussa, harrastuksissa, yhteiskunnallisessa osallistumisessa tai sosiaalisen vuorovaikutuksen ylläpitämisessä. Henkilökohtaisen avun tarkoitus on auttaa vaikeavammaista henkilöä toteuttamaan omia valintojaan. Henkilökohtaisen avun järjestäminen edellyttää, että vaikeavammaisella henkilöllä on voimavaroja määritellä avun sisältö ja toteutustapa. Palveluun kuuluu asiakkaan avustaminen sellaisissa kotioloissa tehtävissä hoitotoimenpiteissä ja lääkehuollossa, jotka asiakas voisi ilman vamman tai sairauden aiheuttamaa rajoitetta tehdä itse. Palveluun kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakkaan terveydentilan seuranta. Hankinnan kohteena on henkilökohtaisen avun palvelu ostopalveluna. Hankinnan kohde kuvataan tarkemmin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen kilpailutuksen liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa. Luokka 2 Tukihenkilöpalvelu Hankinnan kohteena on tukihenkilöpalvelu. Tukihenkilöpalvelua voidaan järjestää vammaispalvelulain 8 §: (vammaisille tarkoitetut palvelut), kehitysvammalain 2 §:n tai sosiaalihuoltolain 16 §:n (sosiaaliohjaus), 17 §:n (sosiaalinen kuntoutus) tai 28 §:n (muut sosiaalipalvelut) perusteella. Tukihenkilöpalvelun tehtävänä on asiakkaan itsenäisen toimintakyvyn tukeminen ja hyvinvoinnin ja edistäminen. Palvelu vahvistaa asiakkaan toimintakykyä ja osallisuutta kaikilla elämän osa-alueilla. Sen tehtävänä on edistää ja tukea asiakkaan itsenäistä suoriutumista ja itsemääräämistä asiakkaan yksilöllisen tarpeen mukaisella tavalla. Palvelu voi olla osana laajempaa palvelukokonaisuutta tai toteutua yksinomaisena. Tukihenkilöpalvelulla tuetaan esimerkiksi asumista, liikkumista, arjen toimintoja, asiointia, sosiaalista vuorovaikutusta, palvelujen käyttämistä, opiskelua tai työssäkäyntiä ja muita vastaavia asioita. Palveluun kuuluu asiakkaan avustaminen sellaisissa kotioloissa tehtävissä hoitotoimenpiteissä ja lääkehuollossa, jotka asiakas voisi ilman vamman tai sairauden aiheuttamaa rajoitetta tehdä itse. Palveluun kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakkaan terveydentilan seuranta. Tukihenkilöpalvelu voi olla valmennuksellista, jolloin sen tavoitteena voi olla uusien taitojen omaksumisen tukeminen. Hankinnan kohde kuvataan tarkemmin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen kilpailutuksen liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa. Luokka 3 Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyö Hankinnan kohteena on vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyö. Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyö on vaativaa, asiakkaan kotona toteutuvaa palvelua, johon sisältyy yleensä kokonaisvaltainen hoito, hoiva ja asiakkaan itsenäisen toimintakyvyn tukeminen asiakkaan tarpeen mukaisesti. Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyötä voidaan järjestää vammaispalvelulain 8 §: (vammaisille tarkoitetut palvelut), kehitysvammalain 2 §:n tai sosiaalihuoltolain 17 §:n (sosiaalinen kuntoutus), 19 §:n (kotipalvelut), 20 §:n (kotihoito) perusteella tai 28 §:n (muut sosiaalipalvelut) perusteella. Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyö voi sisältää terveydenhuoltoon kuuluvia tehtäviä, joiden järjestäminen perustuu terveydenhuoltolakiin (1326/2010). Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyö järjestetään yleensä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilötyövoimalla. Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyön tehtävänä on asiakkaan kotona toteutuvan terveyden- ja sairaanhoidon toteuttaminen, itsenäisen toimintakyvyn tukeminen ja hyvinvoinnin ja edistäminen asiakkaan yksilöllisen tarpeen mukaisesti. Palvelu vahvistaa asiakkaan toimintakykyä ja osallisuutta kaikilla elämän osa-alueilla. Hoito- ja huolenpitotyöhön voi kuulua asiakkaan tarpeen mukaisessa laajuudessa terveydenhuoltolain 25 §:n tarkoittamaa kotisairaanhoitoa. Palvelun tarkoituksena on edistää ja tukea asiakkaan itsenäistä suoriutumista ja itsemääräämistä. Vammaisen asiakkaan hoito- ja huolenpitotyöllä tuetaan esimerkiksi asumista, liikkumista, arjen toimintoja, asiointia, sosiaalista vuorovaikutusta, palvelujen käyttämistä, opiskelua tai työssäkäyntiä ja muita vastaavia asioita. Hankinnan kohde kuvataan tarkemmin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen kilpailutuksen liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa.
